targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(overall_score), 2) AS "Avg CSAT"
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND overall_score IS NOT NULL
  AND IFNULL(ticket_type, 'none') IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Responses"
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND IFNULL(ticket_type, 'none') IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN resolved = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3) AS "Resolved %"
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND IFNULL(ticket_type, 'none') IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN would_return = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3) AS "Would return %"
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND IFNULL(ticket_type, 'none') IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)

SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(staff_name, ''), staff_user_id) AS staff,
  staff_role,
  COUNT(*) AS responses,
  ROUND(AVG(overall_score), 2) AS avg_score,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN resolved = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS resolved_rate,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN speed_rating = 'fast' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS fast_rate
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback_staff
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND staff_role IN ($staff_role)
  AND IFNULL(ticket_type, 'none') IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)
GROUP BY staff_user_id, staff_name, staff_role
ORDER BY avg_score DESC, responses DESC

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(FROM_UNIXTIME(created_at), $__interval) AS time,
  ROUND(AVG(overall_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND overall_score IS NOT NULL
  AND IFNULL(ticket_type, 'none') IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  FROM_UNIXTIME(created_at) AS submitted_at,
  ticket_id,
  ticket_type,
  server,
  overall_score,
  speed_rating,
  resolved,
  would_return,
  closer_user,
  claimer_user,
  first_responder_user,
  LEFT(IFNULL(comment, ''), 200) AS comment
FROM grafana_ticket_feedback
WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(created_at)
  AND IFNULL(ticket_type, 'none') IN ($ticket_type)
  AND IFNULL(server, 'none') IN ($server)
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200
